evidence: Carries the Wallet label and moves HD key derivation logic into CWallet (src/wallet/wallet.cpp) and interfaces.cpp.
rationale: Exposes deriveHDKey on the wallet interface to allow GUI multisig setup workflows to derive shareable xpubs from an HD seed. It refactors functionality already available in RPC to unblock GUI development, making it worthwhile plumbing that can be reasonably deferred.
